Additionally, Colorchips has shown a compounded profit growth of 9% over the past five years, which is above the sector median of 5.0%, suggesting strong fundamentals despite recent negative performance [E17 and E54]. Despite these positive indicators, the company's operating margin has declined sharply from -261 percentage points to -200% in just one quarter [E26], indicating a need for significant improvement. Furthermore, Colorchips' sales have grown by 50% year-over-year (YoY) over the past year, as indicated by the scanX signal engine's screen reason [E58 and E59]. This growth is expected to accelerate earnings growth, which has been accelerating in recent quarters [E61], further supporting its bull case. In conclusion, the evidence suggests that investors may be undervaluing Colorchips New Media Ltd due to concerns about operating margins and sales growth, but the company's strong profit growth over the past five years and its current earnings acceleration provide compelling reasons to consider a bullish stance on the stock.
